INSIDE THE BOOK

Twelve chapters. A practical path.

01 / The problem before the solution

02 / Five stages, one learning loop

03 / Awareness: see before you decide

04 / Strategy: choose a response worth testing

05 / Structure: give the work a place to stand

06 / Systems: make useful work repeatable

07 / Success: ask what changed

08 / A business that people can understand and trust

09 / Learning that becomes usable capability

10 / Community work that can account for its promises

11 / Tools, AI and the work of judgement

12 / Make the practice your own

Also included: an opening note, a guide to using the book, a complete illustrative enquiry-service example, six reusable worksheets, a working glossary and an author profile.

In review, ready to read.

The complete first-edition manuscript is available here. “In review” means the text remains open to the author’s editorial revision; it does not claim external academic peer review. The status is printed inside the book.

Teaching examples are illustrative. The book presents ASSSS as a developing practical framework, with room for testing, criticism and improvement.
